class.name: CgameReplicationGraph
class.brief_description: Decides which entities to replicate to each connection under a bandwidth budget.
class.description: [CgameReplicationGraph] tracks entities in a spatial grid on the X/Z plane. [method gather_for] returns the entities a connection should receive now: - Entities flagged always relevant are candidates for every connection; owner-only entities are candidates only for their owner; all other entities must be within the connection's view radius. - Dormant entities are skipped until [method wake] is called, which forces one replication to every connection with a large priority boost. - Each class has a priority, a minimum update interval in seconds and an estimated size in bytes (see [method set_class_config]). Entities sent less than the interval ago are skipped. - Candidates are sorted by priority (class priority, times proximity, times starvation) and sent until the connection's byte budget is used. Due entities skipped for budget reasons accumulate starvation, which multiplies their priority on later calls so they eventually get through. Time only advances through [method advance]. The graph is meant for thousands of entities per tick; relevancy queries touch only the grid cells overlapping the view radius. [codeblock] var graph := CgameReplicationGraph.new() graph.set_class_config("npc", 1.0, 0.1, 24) graph.add_entity(42, "npc", Vector3(10, 0, 5)) graph.advance(delta) var send := graph.gather_for({"id": 1, "position": player_pos, "view_radius": 150.0, "bandwidth_bytes": 1200}) for item in send: replicate(item["id"]) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_entity
method.description: Registers an entity, replacing any existing entity with the same [param id]. [param owner_id] is the connection id that owns it, or [code]-1[/code] for none.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances the internal clock by [param dt] seconds.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all entities and connection state. Class configuration and the clock are kept.

method.name: gather_for
method.description: Returns the entities to replicate to a connection now and records them as sent. [param connection] has the keys [code]id[/code] (int), [code]position[/code] ([Vector3]), and optionally [code]view_radius[/code] (default [code]100.0[/code]) and [code]bandwidth_bytes[/code] (default effectively unlimited). Each result is a [Dictionary] with [code]id[/code], [code]class[/code], [code]priority[/code] and [code]bytes[/code], ordered by descending priority then ascending id.

method.name: get_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of occupied grid cells.

method.name: get_entity_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered entities.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the position of an entity, or zero and an error if it does not exist.

method.name: has_entity
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the entity is registered.

method.name: is_dormant
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the entity exists and is dormant.

method.name: remove_connection
method.description: Forgets the send history and starvation of a connection.

method.name: remove_entity
method.description: Removes an entity and its per-connection history. Unknown ids are ignored.

method.name: set_class_config
method.description: Sets the replication [param priority], the minimum [param interval] in seconds between sends to one connection, and the estimated packet size in [param bytes] for a class. Unconfigured classes use priority [code]1.0[/code], interval [code]0.0[/code] and [code]32[/code] bytes.

method.name: set_dormant
method.description: Marks an entity dormant or active. Dormant entities are not replicated until woken.

method.name: set_position
method.description: Moves an entity and updates the grid.

method.name: wake
method.description: Clears dormancy and forces one replication to every connection (subject to relevancy and budget).

members.member: Edge length of a grid cell in world units. Changing it rebuilds the grid. Must be greater than zero.
Current time in seconds, advanced by [method advance].
